rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act
rules.requirement: Any landlord planning to end a tenancy must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time as the notice to quit or notice of non-renewal, and must also submit the notice and tenant contact information to the City through its online portal. Violations draw a warning, then fines of $300 per day, but do not halt the eviction.
rules.quoted_span: The Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources should be delivered at the same time as the Notice to quit or Notice of non-renewal of lease.
rules.effective_date_note: Document does not state an effective date.
rules.key_value: Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources with notice to quit; $300/day fine after a warning
rules.penalty: 1st offense: warning; 2nd and subsequent offenses: $300 per day (Inspectional Services Department). Violation does not halt the eviction process.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to all landlords planning to end a tenancy.

parsed.doc_summary: Boston.gov page describing the Housing Stability Notification Act (Boston City Code § 10-11.7), which requires all landlords to give tenants a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources with a notice to quit or non-renewal and to report it to the City, with ISD enforcement fines.
